answer.reason: Several verses tell what Jeshua the son of Jozadak did in rebuilding the altar and the temple, beyond what the summary says.

clauses.english: built the altar of the God of Israel with Zerubbabel and the priests
clauses.quote: builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon

clauses.english: began with Zerubbabel to build the house of God at Jerusalem
clauses.quote: began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem

clauses.english: refused with Zerubbabel to let the adversaries help build the temple
clauses.quote: Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God

doubts: EZR 2:36 (priestly house of Jeshua), EZR 8:33 (Jozabad son of Jeshua) and NEH 12:8 (Levite Jeshua) may concern other men of the name, so I left them out.
EZR 2:2, NEH 7:7, NEH 12:1, NEH 12:7, NEH 12:10, NEH 12:26 and EZR 10:18 only list him, give his descendants or restate the summary, so I did not use them.
